name: xfleet
description: xfleet — multi-repo coordination plugin for Claude Code. Orchestrates parallel agent sessions across repos via Redis Streams: send/listen/ack messages, track concern rounds, and gate phase transitions. Runtime requirements: Redis (default redis://127.0.0.1:6379; override via $XFLEET_REDIS_URL); Python 3 with jsonschema>=4 (used by validate-state.sh on every state-mutating subcommand; override interpreter via $XFLEET_PYTHON); coordination root directory declared via $XFLEET_COORDINATION_ROOT (points to the .xfleet/ tree of the repo under coordination).
